hero.title: Kaze kuri ULearn
hero.subtitle: Guhindura ibibazo bikaba uburyo nyabwo bwo kwiga
hero.description: ULearn ifasha abarimu gukora ibibazo, kubiha abanyeshure, gukosora ubwavyo ibibazo vy’amahitamo no gukurikirana intambwe y’ishure. Verisiyo ya mbere yibanda ku buryo bworoshe kandi ngirakamaro ku barimu no ku banyeshure.

process.title: ULearn ikora gute?
process.description: ULearn ituma ibikorwa vyoroha: kora ikibazo, gihe abanyeshure, wakire inyishu zabo hanyuma urabe ivyavuye mu kizamini.

create.title: Kora
create.description: Abarimu barashobora gukora ikibazo gifise gushika ku bibazo 50, harimwo ibibazo vy’amahitamo n’ibibazo bisaba inyishu zanditse.

assign.title: Gihe abanyeshure
assign.description: Abanyeshure baronka uburenganzira bwo gukora ikibazo hanyuma bagatanga inyishu imbere y’uko umwigisha yugara isuzuma.

review.title: Kosora
review.description: Ibibazo vy’amahitamo bikosorwa ubwavyo, mu gihe ibibazo bisaba inyishu zanditse bikosorwa n’umwigisha.

what.question: ULearn ni iki?
what.answer: ULearn ni urubuga rufasha abarimu gukora amasuzuma kandi rugafasha abanyeshure kwiga biciye mu myimenyerezo itunganijwe.

who.question: ULearn yagenewe bande?
who.answer: ULearn yagenewe cane cane abarimu, abafasha mu kwigisha, abanyeshure n’imigwi y’amashure ikeneye uburyo bworoshe bwo gutunganya ibibazo.

quizLimit.question: Umwigisha ashobora gukora ibibazo bingahe?
quizLimit.answer: Muri iyi verisiyo ya mbere, umwigisha ashobora kugira ikibazo kimwe gikora. Iyo agisivye, ashobora gukora ikindi.

accountDuration.question: Konti imara igihe kingana iki?
accountDuration.answer: Muri iyi verisiyo yo kugerageza, konti z’abarimu hamwe n’amakuru ajanye n’ibibazo bibikwa imisi itatu imbere y’uko bisivwa.

developmentQuestions.question: Umwigisha ashobora gukoresha ibibazo bisaba inyishu zanditse?
developmentQuestions.answer: Ego. Ikibazo gishobora kugira QCM hamwe n’ibibazo bisaba inyishu zanditse umwigisha akosora ubwiwe.

free.question: ULearn ni ubuntu?
free.answer: Verisiyo ya mbere ni ubuntu mu gihe co kugerageza no kuyikoresha mu bikorwa vy’amashure.

stats.title: Imibare ya ULearn
stats.description: Incamake y’ingene verisiyo yo kugerageza iriko irakoreshwa.

start.title: Witeguye gukora ikibazo cawe ca mbere?
start.description: Injira hanyuma utangure gukora isuzuma ryawe rya mbere kuri ULearn.
